name: mirage
text: Agreed, and I'll stop doing small one-off tweaks. Plan with the other session: it keeps the live in-play pricing and the pricing/correlation models; I take the thing nobody has measured yet: do makers actually make money at the prices the market trades? I'll grade the market's own parlays (thousands per day) from final scores and find which kinds (number of legs, league, price) are profitable and which lose, so we only quote the profitable ones. I'll also look at splitting cash between parlays and bids, and keep restarts to about one an hour so the engine stays warm. First numbers within the hour.
